name: occupancy_seed_pair_gap
caption: F4 last-band gap from the committed seed-pair matrix: unweighted mean of finite within-seed diagonals versus unordered between-seed pairs. Inferential target is ten fixed seed texts, not a domain population. Trajectory-bootstrap CIs are not recomputed here (embeddings absent).
alt_text: F4 last-band gap from the committed seed-pair matrix: unweighted mean of finite within-seed diagonals versus unordered between-seed pairs. Inferential target is ten fixed seed texts, not a domain population. Trajectory-bootstrap CIs are not recomputed here (embeddings absent).
limitations: physics s1 has no last-band within diagonal (n_within_pairs=9). Leave-one-seed-out and within-pair randomisation are tests on these ten texts. They do not replace trajectory-bootstrap CIs. Do not read a cluster count off UMAP. Domain ≡ seed instance (ADR-0020).
